state-early.cohort_note: Surgically resected primary tumours, unselected for outcome. Most of these women's disease never becomes metastatic, which is why this cohort stands for the node -- and some of it will, which is the node's caveat.

state-metastatic.cohort_note: Biopsies of metastatic deposits sequenced on MSK-IMPACT (Razavi et al, Cancer Cell 2018), which reports 692 of its 1,918 tumours as previously exposed to hormonal therapy. The study's own primary tumours are excluded here. One sample per patient.
